def VTask.leastOfBdd : {P : ℤ → Prop} → [DecidablePred P] → (b : ℤ) → (Hb : ∀ z, P z → b ≤ z) → (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) → { lb | P lb ∧ ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z } :=
  let pred (n : ℕ) := P (b + n)
  have exists_n : ∃ n, pred n :=
    let ⟨z, hPz⟩ := Hinh
    let h_le := Hb z hPz
    let n := (z - b).natAbs
    have h_eq : b + n = z := by
      simp [n, h_le, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg h_le]
      ring
    ⟨n, h_eq.symm ▸ hPz⟩
  let n_min := Nat.find pred exists_n
  let lb := b + n_min
  have hP_lb : P lb := Nat.find_spec exists_n
  have h_lb_le : ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z := by
    intro z hPz
    let n_z : ℕ := (z - b).natAbs
    have h_le_z : b ≤ z := Hb z hPz
    have h_nz_eq : b + n_z = z := by
      simp [n_z, h_le_z, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg h_le_z]
      ring
    have h_pred_nz : pred n_z := by
      rw [← h_nz_eq] at hPz
      exact hPz
    have h_le_nz : n_min ≤ n_z := Nat.find_min exists_n h_pred_nz
    calc
      lb = b + n_min := rfl
      _ ≤ b + n_z := by linarith [h_le_nz]
      _ = z := h_nz_eq
  ⟨lb, ⟨hP_lb, h_lb_le⟩⟩
